title: Not offended by jazz; fondness for Papa Celestin and Souchon's group
summary: He admits he once may have felt jazz was low but now is not offended, though he would not seek it out. He loves Celestin, When the Saints Go Marching In, and Souchon's group.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
